info.title: AlifWorld Modular Monolith REST API
info.description: Authoritative REST API specification for the AlifWorld e-commerce platform and digital ecosystem. Serves storefront, seller portal, admin backoffice, and Flutter mobile applications with strict BDT/poisha financial precision and dual-language localization (bn-BD / en-BD).

get.description: Returns HTTP 200 if the Next.js process is active and accepting requests.
Returns HTTP 200 if database and cache dependencies are operational.

503.description: One or more critical dependencies unavailable

get.description: Returns platform metadata, supported currencies, minor units, and endpoints.
Returns the raw OpenAPI 3.1 schema JSON document.

post.description: Registers a new customer account, assigns CUSTOMER role, initializes 4 segregated wallets (MAIN, SHOPPING, GOOD_LUCK, CHARITY), and dispatches email verification OTP.

409.description: Account with email or phone already exists

post.description: Verifies a customer email address using a 6-digit ephemeral OTP token. Validates attempt limits (max 3), marks user email as verified, invalidates token, records audit log, and emits auth.email_verified outbox event.

422.description: Verification code expired, invalid, or attempt lockout

post.description: Resends a fresh 6-digit verification code with 60-second cooldown enforcement and 3 requests/hour limit. Returns neutral response for unregistered emails to prevent enumeration.

200.description: Verification code resent successfully or neutral notice

429.description: Rate limit or cooldown exceeded (60s cooldown or max 3 per hour)

post.description: Verifies whether a Bangladesh mobile number is already registered in the system, directing client state to login OTP or guided onboarding registration.
Dispatches a 6-digit ephemeral OTP to the specified Bangladesh mobile number with 60-second cooldown and hourly rate limits.

post.summary: Verify Phone Login OTP & Issue Session
post.description: Verifies 6-digit login OTP for an existing phone user, issues access + rotating refresh tokens, and establishes HttpOnly session cookies.

422.description: Invalid, expired OTP or account lockout

post.description: Verifies 6-digit OTP for an onboarding mobile number and issues a cryptographically signed HMAC registration ticket.
Validates registration ticket, creates customer record, provisions 4 segregated wallets and point account, saves optional demographics, and establishes authenticated session.

422.description: Invalid ticket, password policy mismatch, or validation failure

post.description: Authenticates a user via email or Bangladesh mobile number, issues short-lived JWT access token and single-use rotating refresh token. Sets HttpOnly cookies for web browsers and provides Bearer tokens for mobile Flutter clients.

post.summary: Rotate Refresh Token & Detect Family Reuse
post.description: Rotates a single-use refresh token within an authenticated token family. Issues fresh access token and next-generation refresh token. If a previously consumed token is presented, detects security breach, revokes the entire token family, and terminates active sessions.

401.description: Unauthorized, session expired, or token reuse detected

422.description: Validation failed or refresh token missing

get.description: Retrieves active user profile, assigned RBAC roles, granular permissions, segregated wallet balances, and decoupled loyalty points for the current session.

post.description: Terminates active session in the database, records audit log, and clears HttpOnly authentication cookies.

get.description: Returns all active authenticated sessions and registered devices for the current user, flagging the current session.

delete.description: Revokes a single active session belonging to the authenticated user. If the session is the current one, clears cookies.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the session to terminate

404.description: Session not found or belongs to another user

post.description: Revokes all active sessions for the current user except the current active session.
Terminates all active sessions for the user, increments tokenVersion to immediately invalidate all access tokens, clears cookies, and forces re-login.
Queues a one-time 15-minute password reset link. The response is deliberately neutral for known and unknown email addresses. Requests are limited to one per minute and three per hour per account.

503.description: Reset notification could not be queued

post.description: Consumes a hashed one-time reset token, rejects compromised or reused passwords, updates the password, increments tokenVersion, and revokes every active session atomically.

200.description: Password reset and all sessions revoked

409.description: The one-time token was consumed concurrently

422.description: Invalid token or password policy failure

post.description: Verifies the current password, rejects compromised or reused passwords, changes the credential, increments tokenVersion, and revokes every active session atomically.

200.description: Password changed and all sessions revoked

401.description: Authentication failed or current password is incorrect

get.description: Returns authoritative token TTL configurations, cookie parameters, and password complexity requirements.
Generates an authentic cryptographically signed anti-CSRF token, provisions the aw_csrf cookie, and returns token metadata for client mutation headers.

post.description: RFC 7662 compliant token introspection verifying active state, tokenVersion, and session validity.

get.description: Initiates Google OpenID Connect authorization code flow with HMAC anti-CSRF state token and HttpOnly nonce cookie.

302.description: Redirects to Google accounts authorization page

get.description: Verifies state anti-CSRF cookie, exchanges code for Google tokens, links or registers customer account, initializes 4 segregated wallets, and sets session cookies.

302.description: Redirects to returnUrl with session established in cookies

post.description: Verifies native Google ID token from Flutter SDK, links or provisions customer account, and issues Bearer access and refresh token pair.

get.description: Initiates Facebook OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with HMAC anti-CSRF state token.
Verifies state anti-CSRF token, exchanges code for Facebook access token, links or registers customer account, provisions wallets, and sets session cookies.

302.description: Redirects to returnUrl with session established in cookies

post.description: Verifies native Facebook access token from Flutter SDK, links or provisions customer account, and issues Bearer token pair.

get.description: Retrieves the authenticated customer's own profile. Strictly enforces self-ownership against unauthorized snooping.

put.description: Updates customer profile fields. Strictly prevents modifying internal security fields (status, roles, walletBalance) via privilege escalation barriers.

403.description: Forbidden: Privilege escalation or ownership violation

get.description: Retrieves the authenticated customer's own shopping cart, enforcing strict self-ownership.

post.description: Executes checkout for the customer's owned cart. Prevents checking out carts belonging to another user.

get.description: Returns orders scoped to caller: customers view their own orders; merchants view their fulfillment groups; admins view all orders.

post.description: Executes checkout from an active cart, partitioning items into seller fulfillment groups with exact poisha pricing and independent Product Points snapshotting.

get.description: Returns complete customer parent order details with seller fulfillment groups, courier tracking numbers, and shipment timelines.

200.description: Order details and shipment tracking retrieved

get.summary: Get Order by ID with Object-Level Authorization
get.description: Returns order details if caller is the owning customer, fulfilling merchant, assigned rider, or platform administrator.

post.description: Allows a customer to cancel their own order only while in eligible pending states (PENDING, PLACED, PAYMENT_PENDING).

403.description: Forbidden: Ownership violation or non-cancellable status

get.description: Multi-tenant scoped query returning fulfillment groups and packing items exclusively belonging to the authenticated merchant.

patch.description: Advances fulfillment group along state machine (ACCEPTED, PACKING, READY_FOR_PICKUP, HANDED_OVER_TO_COURIER) with strict tenant verification.

post.description: Creates a pending payment transaction record for digital gateway authorization (bKash, Nagad, etc.) with exact poisha precision.

get.description: Retrieves payment history for the authenticated customer or seller.

post.description: Receives and cryptographically verifies provider IPN events using HMAC SHA-256 signatures with replay deduplication.
Processes a partial or full refund with explicit Product Points rollback, commission adjustments, and ceiling checks.

404.description: Store not found or not public

post.description: Accepts multipart/form-data, validates file size, MIME type, magic signature, authenticated device identifier, and stores the object privately in S3-compatible storage.

put.description: Stores encrypted payout references and returns only masked metadata. This does not execute a payout.

post.summary: Update Seller Suspension or Reactivation State

get.description: Returns tenant-isolated periodic settlement batches for the authenticated seller.
Returns historical electronic funds transfers (BEFTN, RTGS, bKash) disbursed to the seller bank account.
Returns all active staff members with assigned roles and permissions for a merchant store. Strictly tenant-isolated.

parameters.name: sellerId
parameters.description: Optional store identifier (required for Super Admin bypass)

post.summary: Add or Invite Store Staff Member
post.description: Adds an existing user or invites a new person via email/phone as a store staff or manager. Assigns scoped role in IAM and emits outbox event.

delete.description: Removes a staff member from the merchant store and revokes their scoped IAM role assignment.

post.summary: Invite Store Staff Member via Email
post.description: Invites a user by email to join the merchant store staff with specified permissions.

get.description: Returns the authenticated applicant's current seller application without accepting a client-supplied owner identifier.

200.description: Application details and review history retrieved

get.description: Returns support tickets scoped to caller: customers see their own, merchants see their store issues, and support agents see the queue.

post.description: Opens a new incident or inquiry ticket for an authenticated customer or seller.

description.example: The box was torn and contents were broken.

get.description: Retrieves complete ticket message thread and status. Enforces ownership and support authorization.

post.description: Appends a response message from the ticket owner or assigned support agent.

patch.description: Closes or resolves a support ticket.

post.description: Atomically claims an available shipment assignment using lease verification to prevent double-assignment.

403.description: Forbidden: Double-assignment or lacking rider role

post.description: Ingests live coordinates from mobile rider app. Compact JSON, throttled in cache.

get.description: Returns segregated balances for Main, Shopping, Good-Luck, and Charity wallets in integer minor unit poisha.
Retrieves available, pending escrow, and lifetime Product Points with chronological event stream.

get.summary: Get Customer Club Rank & Star Bands
get.description: Returns customer qualification progress across Bronze, Silver, Gold tiers and competitive Star bands.
Queries balanced double-entry journals with debit and credit breakdown conserving zero-sum accounting.
Returns the catalog of all 49 canonical relational Prisma models classified by lifecycle deletion policy (IMMUTABLE, SOFT_DELETE, EPHEMERAL).
Returns applied migration sequences, expand-and-contract phase health, and forward-fix audit records.
Returns all registered languages with active/default status, native names, and word for language translations.

post.description: Dynamically registers a new language code with native display names and RTL/LTR text direction.

patch.description: Designates an active registered language code as the authoritative system-wide default locale.
Updates display name, native name, or toggles active status for a registered language.

delete.description: Removes a non-default language from platform availability.

400.description: Cannot remove default or sole registered language

get.description: Retrieves all platform and custom RBAC roles with system flags and descriptions. Requires roles:read permission.

post.description: Assigns an RBAC role to a user. Seller-scoped roles require sellerId. Enforces maker privileges. Requires roles:assign permission.

403.description: Forbidden: Cannot assign role without requisite privileges

422.description: Validation error: Missing sellerId for seller role or invalid ID

post.description: Revokes a user role assignment. Requires roles:assign permission or SELLER_OWNER for own staff.

403.description: Forbidden: Insufficient privileges to revoke role

get.description: Retrieves all granular permissions grouped by functional module (IAM, SELLER, CATALOG, ORDER, FINANCE, SYSTEM). Requires permissions:read.
Returns paginated, multi-parameter filtered immutable audit log records. Strictly requires Super Administrator authority or system:audit_read permission.

get.summary: Get Audit Log Entry by ID
get.description: Retrieves a single immutable audit log entry by its primary identifier with complete state diff and sanitized metadata.

delete.description: Always returns HTTP 405. Audit records are append-only under ADR-0022 and can never be deleted.

405.description: Method Not Allowed: Audit logs are immutable append-only records.
